confidence_notes: Food and beer estimates are based on Bangkok cost-of-living averages near the July 2026 window. Cocktail and wine estimates use typical bar price multiples of local draft beer, about 3× and 2.5×. Accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; food and drink estimates are Bangkok-specific, while accommodation reflects a large Southeast Asian capital with varied budget and business travel demand.
